title: Orphanage In Mall World?
content: Help! I feel as though I might’ve had a regular dream but I am not sure…Is there an orphanage or place that looks like this in Mall World. I swear Im not joking but I had a dream where I started at school and was sent on a mission to find a teacher (Just so happened to be my grandma who was never a teacher) to give them paperwork and the classroom just so happened to be on the second floor of the mall. It sounds crazy but I got stuck in the mall and when I finally got outside I walked past a creepy park and was teleported to a creepy orphanage full of kids that looks like this picture.
